Hon’ble Manoj Kumar Tiwari, ACJ
Hon’ble Subhash Upadhyay, J.
1. Mr. D.C.S. Rawat, learned Senior Counsel 
assisted by Mr. Munish Bhardwaj, learned 
counsel for the petitioners.
2. Ms. Pooja Banga, learned Standing 
Counsel for the State of Uttarakhand. 
3. Learned State Counsel prays for and is 
granted two weeks time to file short-counter 
affidavit. The reason recorded by Proper Officer,
while authorising search and seizure, shall also 
be brought on record along with such affidavit. 
4. Learned Senior Counsel appearing for the 
petitioners submits that petitioners voluntarily 
deposited ₹15.00 lakh with the State G.S.T. 
Authorities on the day when their premises was 
searched. He, therefore, prays that petitioners 
be protected from coercive action.
5. Till the next date of listing, no coercive 
action shall be taken against the petitioners on 
the strength of impugned order. However, this 
order will not preclude State GST Authorities 
from completing the investigation/assessment. 
6. Stay application (IA No. 1 of 2026) stands 
disposed of. 
(Subhash Upadhyay, J.) (Manoj Kumar Tiwari, ACJ)
 12.10.2026
